# Enrollment Agreement Template

Translator's note: This English text is a prepared translation of the agreement template. It is not an official version of the agreement and has not been approved by the school. In case of any difference, the original-language text prevails.

## 1. Parties

The agreement is concluded between the Example Learning Center ("the School") and the parent or legal guardian of the student.

## 2. Term

The agreement is concluded for one academic year and may be extended by written consent of both parties.
